analysis.title: Tactical Takes: More De-grossing and HF Pain
key_insights: US stocks reversed lower on Thursday 11/5, with the sharpest declines in Tech but broad enough to produce negative returns across all HF strategies. The global HF return was worse than a 3z decline on the day, continuing the past month's challenges.

Global HF returns were -1.6% on Thursday and about -1.8% MTD. The 1-day return is the worst since Apr 4, 2025, and the 3-month net return is at a -3z level, in line with early Apr 2025. Most of the Thursday loss was beta-related, at least in the US.
Regional and strategy returns are mostly -1% to -2% MTD. Alpha is most negative for Quants in North America, Multi-Strats in EMEA and Equity L/S in APAC.

HF de-grossing ran a 4th straight day at about 1.5z on Thursday, similar to late July/early Aug. Net flows are flat because both longs and shorts are being cut. The Multi-Strat 20-day de-gross is larger than any other period outside Covid.

The US Tactical Positioning Monitor (TPM) fell 1.7z on the week to the 20th percentile since 2015, similar to the March and July 2026 lows. The 4-week change is only -0.5z (3-day average) against the -1.5z trigger JPM uses for an attractive set-up, so it is not yet a clear buying signal.
Much of the recent pain was rotational rather than a broad index decline until Thursday, which limited the speed of the TPM decline.

Semis were the clearly sold group. Retail sold Semis and other AI-related industries on Thursday. HFs have net sold Semis at nearly a 4z level over the past month, though HF Semis flows were closer to neutral on Thursday after large selling on Wednesday.
HF rolling 1-month Semis selling is back at the July 2026 level. On 2-month and 3-month bases the selling is around 4z, which JPM says has not been seen in past data.

sector_views.rationale: Not a bank rating. HFs and retail were heavy net sellers, with HF net selling near 4z over 1 month and around 4z over 2 and 3 months.

risk_factors: Continued HF de-grossing, which is accelerating after persistent de-grossing over several weeks.
Retail selling and general de-risking in US stocks.
Further selling in Semis and AI-related industries from HFs and retail.
Positioning has not reached JPM's -1.5z trigger for an attractive entry, so there may be more room for de-risking.
